J05.why: The cut is clean. The same card template, background and layout continue across the join, and the Homestead marker card is on screen while the narration finishes 'what that cost at Homestead'. The new 'March 1901 / J. P. Morgan' card is already up at +0.5s, as the Morgan sentence starts. Two weaknesses: it is a hard cut with no dissolve, and the new card is sparse. It shows only two short lines ('the banker approaches / Carnegie') and leaves a lot of empty space. It does not mention Schwab, who is named in the narration.

fix_if_any: Add a ~0.3–0.5s crossfade or slide between the two cards. Fill the March 1901 card by adding a 'Charles Schwab' line or node linking Morgan and Carnegie (e.g. 'approached through Charles Schwab'), or by enlarging the text, so the card matches the narration and is less empty.
